---
title: "RFC 017: Ingestion Service Phase"
subtitle: "Bounded Service Loop for Scheduling"
date: 2026-01-19
---

## Executive Summary

This phase adds a bounded ingestion service loop that repeats ingestion cycles until idle. It reuses the ingestion loop helper and adds service‑level state for cycles and idle counts, enabling a deterministic scheduler without a daemon.

## Implementation Scope

| Area | Deliverable | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Service result | `IngestionServiceResult` | Tracks cycles, idle cycles, and loop outputs. |
| Service loop | `run_ingestion_service` | Stops after idle limit or cycle max. |
| Tests | Idle exit | Validates service exit when no ready files appear. |

: Table 1. Service loop deliverables.

## Code Changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/autoclean/utils/ingestion.py` | Added service loop helper and result model. |
| `tests/unit/utils/test_ingestion.py` | Added idle exit test for service loop. |

: Table 2. Code updates delivered.
